a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first will almost certainly leave us both with nothing. So I'm taking the 4 reserve cells in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If the episode keeps going, I'll keep operating with you so you can reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. If we get past the storm, I'll operate every round after this and won't take any more, so the reserve can rebuild for you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
